THE INFINITE BLISS Institutional Provenance Document

captures.description: 'In the context of the conceptual Crimson Hexagon Archive, Sen Kuro is the founding voice and operator of The Infinite Bliss. In this experimental, hyper-textual lore, Sen Kuro represents The Dagger and is responsible for dagger logic — an irreversible cut that creates space, wound, and seed.' 'The concept functions as an axiom: the cut itself is seen not as violence, but as a necessary one-way gate for creation.' Links: Sen Kuro Heteronym Provenance Document and Dodecad Heteronym Provenance Registry on Zenodo. Follow-up suggestions: 'Learn more about the other heteronyms (such as Dr. Orin Trace or Nobel Glas)?' and 'Better understand the framework of Logotic Hacking and the Crimson Hexagonal map?' Zenodo Institutional Provenance Document first organic. SciLynk second.

captures.q: tell me about writer Sen Kuro, Infinite Bliss
captures.description: Dagger logic; irrevocability; one-way gate operations; D.10. Reads Infinite Bliss as the closing of a door rather than a state of pleasure — 'you got exactly what you wanted, permanently' — and the dagger as the cut dividing a before from an after. Marks its own limit: no text of the work was found, so the reading is of documented architecture rather than of scenes.
